market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain risk-averse with Dow down 600 points on oil spike and Middle East jitters. Oil >$100 and gas records will pressure consumer sentiment through Q4. ECB rate hike and bond auction risk add volatility. Tech sector provides relative strength (TSMC, Apple, Meta) but cannot offset broad-based energy-driven inflation fears. Expect 5-8% VIX elevation through September.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and equities recover within 3-6 months. AI capex cycle (Apple foldable, Arm edge, Snowflake flywheel) supports 12-month tech outperformance. Trade war with Canada may persist 6-12 months, pressuring North American industrials. India and Africa emerge as structural growth beneficiaries. Gold likely sustains >$4,200 on central bank buying and geopolitical premium. Inflation remains sticky, delaying Fed easing to H2 2027.
